games.title: Nuts Puzzle: Sort By Color
games.description:
Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color is a classic puzzle game where you sort various colored nuts onto screws until they are all the same color.

As you progress through the levels, the puzzles get trickier, requiring you to plan your moves carefully and think several steps ahead. With each successful sort, you'll feel a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Get ready to test your strategy and problem-solving skills as you work your way through increasingly complex and colorful challenges!
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: It is a puzzle game where players sort color-coded nuts onto matching bolts.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? What makes it engaging for players?
A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are Coins, which can be spent on in-game power-ups, such as an extra bolt for sorting nuts. There is also a separate currency, Nuts, which can be spent on ""repairing"" the garden.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or anything similar that encourages players to return?
A: There is a money piggy bank, and Coins are collected while the player is away from the game. Additionally, there is a Chest that can be opened upon reaching certain in-game levels, which can drop rewards like game bonuses and in-game currency.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties in completing levels?
A: It is not necessary.
games.howToPlay:
Organize the nuts

To play Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color, start by tapping on the nut you want to move, then select the screw where you want to place it. You can only place a nut on another screw if it’s either empty or if the top nut on that screw matches the color of the nut you’re moving. This simple rule sets the stage for the puzzle-solving challenge, as you’ll need to strategically plan your moves to ensure each screw ends up with nuts of a single color.
As you progress, the game introduces more nuts and a wider range of colors, making the puzzles increasingly complex. New challenges, such as hard mode levels, add an extra layer of difficulty by hiding the color of nuts until you move a piece from above them. These added twists will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you work through each level, striving to complete the puzzle with fewer moves and greater efficiency.

Use helpers

It’s at this point that you may need to use the undo, reset, and extra screw options, which are available on every level. However, you can only win extra screws from chests and from the winner's wheel. Clicking the screw icon adds an extra screw to free up more space. The undo button has a finite number of uses, but these are restored on each level. You can use the reset button to start the level over from scratch if you have no choice.

games.title: Sudoku Online
games.description:
Sudoku Puzzle is a free online Sudoku game. No registration, play instantly in your browser.

The classic mode offers four difficulty levels: Easy for beginners, Medium for steady practice, Hard for experienced players, and Expert for those who seek a real challenge. Additional game modes expand the standard rules: X-Sudoku adds diagonal constraints, Windoku introduces extra regions on the grid, Killer Sudoku requires groups of cells to meet a target sum, and Kropki adds ratio and difference markers between adjacent cells.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable through pure logic — no guessing required. If you get stuck, a step was missed somewhere, and it can always be traced back.

Sudoku Puzzle is also a competitive experience. Leaderboards track rankings by level, score, and wins. Personal profiles store game history and detailed statistics. The chat lets players connect, share strategies, and challenge each other.
games.howToPlay:
The goal is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits from 1 to 9 so that each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and 3×3 box. Some cells are pre-filled — these are your starting clues.

Begin with cells that have the most filled neighbors: fewer options make it easier to identify the correct digit. As cells are filled in, the choices for adjacent ones narrow down — the puzzle unfolds as a chain of logical steps.

Use the notes mode to write down multiple candidates in a cell and eliminate them as the grid fills up. This is especially useful at Hard and Expert levels.

Additional modes come with extra rules. In X-Sudoku, digits must also be unique along both main diagonals. In Windoku, extra highlighted regions apply the same uniqueness rule. In Killer Sudoku, groups of cells must add up to a given sum. In Kropki, markers between cells define relationships: a white dot means the two digits differ by 1, a black dot means one is exactly twice the other.

Train your mind!

games.howToPlay:
Objective: The main goal is to match and crush candies to complete specific objectives within a limited number of moves.

Matching Candies: Players can swap adjacent candies to create a row or column of three or more matching candies. This will make them disappear and score points.

Striped Candies: Made by matching four candies in a row; they clear an entire row or column when matched.
Wrapped Candies: Made by matching five candies in a T or L shape; they explode and clear surrounding candies.
Color Bombs: Created by matching five candies of the same color; they clear all candies of that color when combined with any candy.

games.description:
Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board. One correct move can open the way forward, while a single mistake can trigger a chain reaction that costs you a heart.

As you progress, the game evolves into a full arrow maze escape experience featuring twisting paths, looping routes, and increasingly complex layouts. Some stages feel like isolated arrow-filled arenas where every direction represents either danger or opportunity, turning each decision into a tense test of planning and precision.

The core mechanic revolves around tapping arrows out in the correct order. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, and with only three hearts available, every move matters. Make three mistakes and the attempt ends immediately, pushing you to think carefully before each tap. To complete a level, you must clear all arrows before time runs out, creating a high-pressure challenge that tests both focus and reaction speed.

Gameplay blends intuitive tap and swipe controls with advanced puzzle mechanics, encouraging players to adapt their strategy as new movement patterns and hazards appear. Certain levels demand quick thinking and precise timing, rewarding players who can stay calm under pressure.

More than a simple arrow puzzle, Arrow Escape is a layered challenge of strategy, speed, and skill. Whether you’re navigating a dense arrow maze, solving a tight exit puzzle, or racing against the clock in a last-second escape, every level pushes your problem-solving abilities to the limit.

games.title: Park Sort
games.description:
Park Sort is a colorful parking puzzle where every move is clear and every choice matters.

Every vehicle has an arrow on its roof. Tap it and it drives straight that way. If the road is clear, it leaves the lot and heads for the garage of its color. If something is in the way, it bumps and comes back.

Garages arrive one after another, and each one fills in order: big vehicles first, then cars, then bikes. A car that can leave right now isn't always one that should. Cars with nowhere to go wait in the parking slots and drive into their garage as soon as it opens. But if the waiting slots fill up, it's game over!

Features

- Simple one-tap controls with clear arrows: you always know where a vehicle will go
- Color sorting with a twist: big vehicles park first
- New vehicles and gimmicks as you play: trucks, bikes, traffic lights, barriers & keys, mystery cars, and more on the way
- Handy boosters: Undo, Hint, +Slot and Scan
- Collect garage skins and fill your album
- Daily rewards, win streak bonuses, and a 100-player rally race
- Bright candy-colored toy cars and smooth, satisfying animations
- No timers, no rush: think at your own pace
- Clear the jam, sort every car and become the best parking manager in town!
games.howToPlay:
1. Tap a vehicle to drive it in the direction of its roof arrow.
2. If the path is clear, it leaves the lot and heads to the open garage of the same color.
3. Each garage fills in order: big vehicles first, then cars, then bikes. Check the empty spaces in the garage.
4. Vehicles that can't park yet wait in the parking slots and drive in automatically when their garage opens.
5. Don't let the waiting slots fill up! When all slots are full, the level ends.
6. Watch the NEXT list to see which garages come next, and plan your moves.
7. Stuck? Use boosters: Undo takes back a move, Hint shows a good move, +Slot adds a waiting slot, and Scan locks vehicles that can't park right now.

Use boosters when stuck: Hammer smashes a stack, Shuffle gives new tray stacks, Undo takes back your last move. Works with mouse and touch.

games.title: Patchwise
games.description:
Patchwise is a calm logic puzzle about bojagi, the Korean art of sewing scraps of cloth into one wrapping cloth.

Each board is an empty cloth, and the tray below it shows the patches you have to use. Drag across the cells to sew a patch, and fill the whole cloth so that every patch in the tray is used exactly once. Patches may be turned and flipped.

10 worlds, 285 hand-picked puzzles
Every world adds one new rule on top of the last:
• Patchwork: use exactly the patches in the tray.
• Knots: a knot shows the size of the patch it sits on.
• Holes: leave the holes empty.
• Stitches: stitched cells must belong to the same patch.
• Seams: a seam line must stay a border between two patches.
• Buttons: every patch gets exactly one button.
• Grain: a patch must run longer along the grain of the cloth.
• Printed: printed patches cannot be turned or flipped.
• Colored Buttons: same color, same patch; different colors, different patches.
• Corner Knots: a corner knot counts the patches meeting at that corner.

More to sew
• Daily Bojagi: a new cloth every day, mixing the rules you have learned.
• Sewing Cup: 100 sewers race through 5 cloths in a row. Use a hint and you're out.
• Kkachi's workshop: spend your stars to furnish the magpie's sewing room.
• Food cards: finish a world's bojagi and Kkachi wraps a traditional Korean treat in it.
• Decorate your frame, cloth, thread and lattice, and dress up Kkachi.

No timer, no lives, no fail state. Take your time.
games.howToPlay:
Fill the whole cloth with the patches shown in the tray below the board. Use each patch exactly once. Patches may be turned and flipped.

• Drag across the cells to sew a patch.
• Drag on from the end of a patch to make it longer.
• Tap a patch to remove it.
• UNDO takes back your last move. RESET clears the board.
• Stuck? HINT sews one correct patch for you. Pinned patches came from a hint and stay put.

Each cloth gives up to 2 stars: one for finishing it, one for finishing without hints. Collect half the stars in a world to open the next one. You don't have to finish every cloth.

games.title: Rebound Rascals
games.description:
Rebound Rascals is a bouncy monster roguelite where every shot ends in a big BONK.
Aim at the peg board and let go: your marble bounces from peg to peg, and every peg it hits adds damage. Then your monster hero throws all that power at the cheeky rascals marching up the lane, before they bonk you first.

New to peg-board roguelites?
Your first fight is won in seconds, and the game shows you each idea the first time it appears: gold pegs that turn the whole shot into a critical hit, bombs that blow up on every rascal, a green peg that brings the board back, and Chompy, who swallows your marble at the bottom of the board so you can shoot again.

12 marbles, 24 trinkets and 17 rascals, 3 of them bosses, across three acts.
Every run takes a new path: pick a door for a fight, a tough elite, a shop, a campfire, a treasure chest or a mystery, fill your bag with marbles that split, zap, burn, freeze or roll through pegs, and stack trinkets that bend the rules. Stars from every run unlock new marbles, new trinkets, three more heroes and spicier difficulty levels.

Play the way you like. Drag to aim with the dotted guide, let go to shoot, tap a rascal to choose your target, and hold the board to speed up a long shot. A new Daily Dash every day, the same for everyone, keeps your streak going, and the Monsterpedia fills up with every rascal you meet.

Rebound Rascals speaks English, French and Spanish, and your run is saved after every turn, so you can stop and come back whenever you like.
games.howToPlay:
Beat the rascals walking up the lane before they reach your hero. Each shot, your marble bounces through the peg board: every peg hit adds damage, gold pegs make the whole shot a critical hit, red bombs hit every rascal, the green peg brings popped pegs back, and Chompy at the bottom hands the marble back for another shot. Win fights, pick a door on the path, collect marbles and trinkets, and bonk the boss at the end of each of the three acts.

Mouse or touch: drag on the board to aim (the dotted line shows the first bounce), let go to shoot. Tap a rascal to make it your target. Hold the board to speed up a shot.
Keyboard: Left and Right arrows aim, Space or Enter shoots, Escape pauses, M mutes.

You steer Mina, gather the candle motes the fallen leave behind, and every level pick one of three midnight rites — orbiting candles, homing charms, a supper chime, frost, meteors and more — so every run is a new build. Bosses wake every 45 seconds and the dream breaks at five minutes. Between runs, spend Candles in the Coven Shop and on the 177-star Moon Tree, clear daily and weekly tasks, collect trophies, fill the bestiary and open five dreams, from the Midnight Kitchen to the Witch's Attic.

Pick up glowing candle motes to level up. Survive bosses and reach the morning to clear a dream and open the next one. Spend Candles on the Moon Tree and in the Coven Shop between runs.

games.title: Eat Blobs Simulator
games.description:
Enter the Colorful Blob Arena
Eat Blobs Simulator is a competitive growing game where tiny slimes can become enormous arena champions. Choose your favorite blob, enter a nickname, and begin collecting the colorful slime pieces spread across the map. Every piece you eat increases your size and brings you closer to the top of the arena.

Growing also changes which opponents you can challenge. Smaller blobs become valuable targets, but larger players can end your run if you get too close. Watch the sizes around you, choose safe routes, and wait until you are strong enough before beginning the hunt.

Eat, Grow, and Take Control
The main objective is to become the biggest blob in the arena. Start by collecting the small pieces around the map, then chase opponents who are smaller than you. Eating another slime can provide a major growth boost and quickly improve your position.

Do not focus only on nearby targets. A larger opponent may be approaching from behind, and chasing one small blob too far can lead you into danger. Camera control and map awareness are important, especially once the arena becomes crowded.

Unlock New Blob Skins
Earn coins and rewards while playing, then use them to unlock different blob appearances. New skins let you enter future matches with a fresh look while continuing to improve your performance.

Your rewards depend on the size you reach, the coins you collect, and how well you perform during each round. Even a short run can help you build toward another skin or give you a better start in the next match.

Play Solo or With a Friend
Eat Blobs Simulator supports single-player and local two-player gameplay. Solo mode gives you full camera and zoom control as you explore the arena and compete against other blobs.

In two-player mode, you can share the same device with a friend. Collect slime pieces, grow faster than the other player, and decide whether to explore separate parts of the arena or compete for the same targets. The simple controls make it easy to begin, but becoming the largest blob still requires smart movement.

How to Play
Move around the arena and eat the small slime pieces to grow. Once you are larger than another blob, chase and consume it for a bigger reward. Stay away from opponents that are larger than you, because they can eat your character.

Keep collecting until you become one of the strongest blobs in the arena.

Helpful Tips
Collect nearby slime pieces before challenging other players.
Compare sizes carefully before beginning a chase.
Keep moving so larger blobs cannot trap you.
Use open areas when you need to escape.
Avoid following a target without checking what is behind you.
In two-player mode, do not let the other player take every safe group of slimes.

Main Features
Colorful eating-and-growing arena gameplay
Single-player and local two-player modes
Smaller blobs to hunt and larger opponents to avoid
Coins, performance rewards, and unlockable skins
Simple keyboard and mouse controls
Mobile and tablet joystick support
Quick matches with increasing competition
Easy-to-learn rules with strategic movement
Eat Blobs Simulator turns a simple growing idea into a lively arena battle. Collect, grow, unlock new looks, and prove that your slime can become the king of the blob arena.

games.title: Soak & Squeeze

Soak up water, then squeeze it out to blast yourself across floating islands over a bottomless gap! Every world is completely different: a toy kitchen, a bubble bath with giant soap bars, a toy box with ABC blocks and conveyor belts, a windy garden, and a rainbow sky of clouds. Ride water slides, get fired from cannons, bounce on trampolines, smash foam walls and fly through boost rings. Fall or run dry and you are back at the start, but every bit of progress earns drops: spend them to upgrade your sponge with a bigger tank, more power and more income, plus wings, a rain cloud and rescue bubbles. Each world gives you a brand-new sponge to grow again. Can you reach the far-away goal?

While you still have water, you can pull once more in mid-air to jump again. Land on blue OASIS islands to refill water automatically. Use trampolines, cannons and water slides to cross the big gaps, smash walls and fly through rings for bonus drops. If you fall or run out of water, spend your drops on upgrades and try again. Reach the GOAL to unlock the next world. Keyboard: hold Space to charge, arrow keys to turn, release to fly.

games.title: Bean Tower
games.description:
About Bean Tower: Run, Jump and Combo Your Way to the Sky

Bean Tower is an endless arcade climber. Run, jump and bounce off the walls to climb as high as you can before the scrolling tower leaves you behind. Speed is everything: the faster you run, the higher you jump, and chaining big jumps into combos earns huge points. Every 100 floors the tower adds a new twist, so each climb gets wilder the higher you go.

Tower Twists
Floor 100: slippery ice
Floor 200: windows that can throw you out of the tower
Floor 300: crumbling floors
Floor 400: moving platforms
Floor 500: conveyor belts
Floor 600: springs and boost pads
Floor 700: blinking platforms
Floor 800: wind gusts
Floor 900: icicles and snowballs
Floor 1000: sticky goo walls and bumpers
Floor 1100: low gravity

Game Modes
Tower: a new twist every 100 floors.
Classic: the pure original rules.
Daily Tower: the same tower for everyone today, with a daily twist.
Ghost Race: race the ghost of your best run.
Mutators: pick 1 of 3 rule-changing cards every 100 floors.
Sprint 250: reach floor 250 as fast as you can.
Hardcore: no power-ups, and one hit ends the run.
Gauntlet: every twist by floor 100, for 1.5× score.
Practice: start from any checkpoint you've reached.

Characters
Bean: the all-rounder.
Imp (Fireproof): smashes icicles and snowballs.
Bot (Magnet): pulls in nearby coins.
Frog (Big Hops): jumps 5% higher.
Penguin (Ice Skater): ice feels like a normal floor.
Cat (Nine Lives): starts every run with a shield.
Boo (Featherweight): floatier jumps.
Golden Bean (Midas): coins are worth 25% more.

Power-ups
Shield, Double Jump, Slow Clock, Rocket and Combo Freeze.

Unlocks
Earn coins and diamonds, level up, complete daily and weekly missions, fill your sticker album and chase achievements. Spend them on characters, 5 tower themes (Frost Tower, Ember Keep, Neon Spire, Candy Castle, Jungle Temple), 9 hats, 9 trails, 6 landing effects, 5 music styles and upgrades, then climb the leaderboard.
games.howToPlay:
How to Play Bean Tower: Climb, Combo, Survive

Climb as high as you can. Soon after you start, the tower begins to scroll up, and every 30 seconds it speeds up (HURRY UP!). Fall off the bottom of the screen and the run ends.

Run before you jump: the faster you run, the higher you jump. Walls bounce you back at full speed, so use them to turn without slowing down.

Combos: jump two or more floors at a time, again and again within 3 seconds. The longer the combo, the bigger the bonus.

Grab coins, diamonds and power-up bubbles on the way, and spend them in the shop between runs.

Controls
Keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to run; Space, Up or W to jump; Esc or P to pause.
Touch: hold the arrow buttons at the bottom left to run (or anywhere on the left half of the screen); tap the jump button or anywhere on the right half to jump.
Gamepad: d-pad or left stick to run; A or d-pad up to jump; Start to pause.

games.title: Log Flyer: Grandpa Takes Off
games.description: Build a flying log and send Grandpa soaring across a snowy mountain valley! Launch from a ramp, balance your flight, and earn coins to upgrade the nose cone, wings, engine, fuel tank, and ramp. Complete permanent missions, unlock colorful paint jobs and pilot titles, meet a startled eagle, and reach the village to earn a cheerful piglet copilot. The village is not the finish line: keep flying and chase your best single-flight distance on the SCORE leaderboard. Includes English and Russian text and voice acting.
games.howToPlay: Press Let's Fly to launch. On desktop, hold W or Up Arrow to raise the nose, S or Down Arrow to lower it, and Space to run the installed engine. Release Space to glide and save fuel. On mobile, hold the round up and down buttons on the left to steer, and hold the engine button on the right for thrust. Earn coins after each flight, buy and equip upgrades in the workshop, and fly farther. Reach the village at 6 km, then continue toward a new distance record. An optional video reward in the workshop grants 300 coins only after a completed ad. Open Settings for sound, language, and control instructions.

games.title: Geometry Vibes
games.description: Geometry Vibes is a reaction-based arcade game where you avoid obstacles, traps and spikes that come at you in waves. Your goal in the game is to keep your arrow on the route and take it as far as possible. Geometry Vibes, where the excitement never ends, invites you to challenge.
games.howToPlay:
How to Play Geometry Vibes?

The game is quite simple to play, but difficult to master.
Try to continue without hitting obstacles.

Click to "MOUSE LEFT-CLICK" or "UP ARROW" and hold to fly up.

Release the button to dive down.

In 2,3,4 Player game modes, players are controlled with "UP ARROW", "H" and "L". (MOUSE LEFT-CLICK and SPACE keys can also be used instead of W.)

games.title: Solar Smash
games.description:
Solar Smash is a fun game that allows you to fully embrace cosmic power and create or destroy planets as you wish. You can choose from a variety of different weapons and use them to destroy planets and moons. Additionally, you can create your own planetary systems and customize them as you wish.

Solar Smash is also an opportunity to unleash your creativity and create worlds or destroy them in your hands. You can tear apart planets, cause supernovas and create black holes that consume everything in their path. The game has intuitive controls that are suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

Overall, Solar Smash is an addictive game that allows you to harness cosmic power and create or destroy planets at will. If you love physics simulators and space, then this game is definitely for you!
games.howToPlay:
The goal of the game is to destroy all planets using a variety of weapons.
Control on a mobile device: touch/swipe.
Control on desktop: left mouse button.

games.title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
games.description:
Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! 🌟

What Makes Shape Transforming: Shifting Run Exciting:
🏃‍♂️ Thrilling Transformations: Seamlessly morph into different characters to tackle the challenges of each terrain. Each transformation is a new experience!
🏃‍♂️ Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a game with beautifully rendered environments and characters, making every run a visually stunning journey.
🏃‍♂️ Hilarious Animations and Fun Sound Effects: Enjoy the game's playful side with funny animations and entertaining sound effects that add to the overall enjoyment.
🏃‍♂️ Fast-Paced Gameplay: The game's rapid pace demands quick reflexes and decision-making, providing an exhilarating challenge for players of all skill levels.
🏃‍♂️ Engaging for Everyone: Whether you’re a seasoned gamer or just looking for an exciting new game to play, Shape Transforming: Shifting Run is accessible and enjoyable for all.
games.howToPlay: In Shape Transforming, you're not just running a race; you're mastering the elements of land, air, and sea. As you dash through each unique terrain, you must transform into the right character to navigate obstacles and keep moving forward. Be it a car on land, an airplane in the air, or a ship in the sea – each form has its strengths and challenges!

games.title: Snow Rush 3D
games.description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fast-paced winter action game where your reflexes and timing are put to the test on icy tracks. Ride your sled through endless snowy paths, dodge trees, snowmen, and barriers, and try to travel as far as possible without crashing. Snow Rush 3D offers both single-player and two-player modes, letting you compete with a friend on the same device. Each run becomes more challenging as your speed increases, making every second a true test of focus and control.

Collect gifts along the way to unlock new sleds and add variety to your runs. With smooth controls, clean 3D visuals, and an addictive gameplay loop, Snow Rush 3D delivers quick and exciting sessions that are easy to start but hard to master.
games.howToPlay:
PLAYER 1:

W or SPACE: Jump

PLAYER 2:

RIGHT / LEFT ARROWS: Left / Right Movements
UP ARROW: Jump
On Mobile Devices:

Only 1 Player mode is enabled on mobile devices. Tap left and right on the screen to move left and right. Tap with two fingers to jump.

games.title: Geometry: Black Wave
games.description:
“Geometry: Black Wave” is a musical platformer game in which the player controls a small arrow, overcoming various obstacles and hurdles on the way to the finish line. The game features black and white graphics and an exciting soundtrack that is synchronized with the gameplay.

The game offers many levels of varying difficulty, each with its own unique music. The player must react quickly to obstacles and move in the right direction to reach the end of the level.

“Geometry: Black Wave” is a game that requires the player to react quickly and move accurately. It is suitable for all ages and skill levels, and can be a great way to pass the time and have fun.

"Geometry: Black Wave" can be tricky, but with these detailed instructions, you'll be able to master it in no time:
1. Start the game and select a level. The difficulty of the level depends on the emoji drawn on the button.

4. To move downward, release the screen. This will cause the wave to start moving downward until it reaches the ground.

games.title: Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish
games.description: This game is a physics-based puzzle experience that reimagines the bubble shooter genre. Built around a rotating hexagonal structure, each level challenges players to adapt to changing angles, motion, and gravity. With an ocean-themed visual style and a light narrative about a crab rescuing a clownfish, the game delivers a fresh combination of strategy, physics, and immersive design.
games.howToPlay: Aim and launch bubbles toward the hexagonal structure. Impacts may trigger rotation, changing the direction and behavior of bubbles in real time. Use timing, angles, and structural movement to clear bubbles and complete level objectives.

games.title: Rooftop Run
games.description:
Rooftop Run – Race Across the City! 🏃‍♂️💨

Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.
games.howToPlay:

Cool Parkour Moves – Jump, roll, and slide to keep running.

Fast Levels – Complete thrilling challenges and master your skills.

Simple Controls – Easy to learn, fun to play!

Be the best parkour runner! Play Rooftop Run now and start your adventure!

games.title: Get Tall And Fall
games.description:
An exciting adventure in which you have to boost your growth with a variety of food, pets, potions and other methods.

Conquer the peaks of each location, discover new worlds and take the lead among the players!

WASD Management
Space - Jump

RMB - Rotate camera

Pets give income multipliers
Potions give powerups
The higher the world, the more difficult it is to level up

Joystick on the left - Movement
The buttons on the right are Jump/Purchase

games.title: Mushroom Runners
games.description: Run endlessly in Mushroom Runners! Dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow HUGE! Ride the Happy Flying Cloud in this fun, fast-paced endless runner with a unique platforming twist.
games.howToPlay:
Mobile: touch the screen to jump, swipe down to stomp the ground.

Desktop: press up key to jump, press down key to stomp the ground.

games.title: Pocket Universe
games.description:
Pocket Universe is an adventure game where players build and expand their own tiny world.

1. Gather resources (wood, stone, metal, crystals) and use them to unlock new lands.

2. Discover diverse biomes: lush meadows, frozen tundras, volcanic regions, and more.

3. Upgrade your tools to harvest rare materials.

4. Face enemies — monsters, golems, and wild creatures guarding unexplored areas.

5. Step by step, your little world will grow into a whole universe.
games.howToPlay:
How to Play
Use the joystick to move your character. Collect resources by mining rocks, trees and crystals. Spend them to upgrade tools, unlock new hexes, explore fresh biomes and fight enemies on your way!

games.title: Geometry: Black Ball
games.description:
Geometry: Black Ball is an exciting arcade game based on the legendary Geometry Dash. In this game, you have to control the ball and overcome various obstacles using the unique mechanics of gravity change.

The game includes 10 levels of varying difficulty, each of which is an exciting challenge and requires the player to have quick reactions and precise movements. The further you advance, the more difficult the obstacles become, adding an additional challenge to the game.

In addition, Geometry: Black Ball has a shop where the player can purchase various skins for his ball. You can choose from a variety of stylish and creative skins to give your ball a unique look and enhance the feel of the game.

Get ready for an exciting adventure that will test your dexterity and reaction!
games.howToPlay:
In the game "Geometry: Black Ball" you play as a ball from "Geometry Dash". To start the game, select one of the 10 levels that have different difficulty levels displayed by emojis on the level buttons. After selecting a level, the gameplay begins.

During the game, you can change the gravity of the ball by pressing the space bar or right mouse button to overcome obstacles. This will help you change the direction of the ball and overcome obstacles on the way to the finish line.

Your task is to get through all the obstacles and reach the finish line of each level. Be careful and react quickly to overcome the challenges you will face.

Use your skills and strategies to successfully complete each level and advance further. Have fun in an exciting adventure in the game "Geometry Dash: Black Ball"!

games.title: Hole Feast
games.description: Hole Feast is a bite-sized .io-style munch-fest! Drag to glide your glowing hole across colorful low-poly picnics, cities and farms. Snacks, cars, cows and whole buildings tumble in as you grow: SIZE UP! Chain gulps into combos, outgrow three hungry rival holes in 90-second battles or clear 100% of the map. Earn coins, upgrade size, speed and time, and unlock 8 dazzling rim skins.
games.howToPlay: Drag anywhere on the screen (or use WASD / arrow keys) to move your hole. Objects smaller than the hole fall in and make it grow. Swallow smaller rival holes and avoid bigger ones. Finish first in the 90-second battle or clear 100% of the map to win coins, then upgrade your start size, speed and time.

games.title: Deadly Descent
games.description:
Drive your car down the mountain and get to the end of the track in one piece!
"Deadly Descent" is a fascinating car simulator.
games.howToPlay:
"Deadly Descent" is a simulator of driving down a mountain by car. You need to get to the finish line.. The difficulty is that there are a large number of obstacles on the track, a collision with which will destroy your car, so you should drive very carefully.

This driving simulator is for those who enjoy different types of car destruction. Now you can complete them on your phone or computer completely free of charge.

The game features destructible cars and realistic driving simulation. Despite the well-developed physics and realistic graphics, the game does not require many resources from the device and will give you a realistic driving experience on any device.

Compete with other players! Each unique track has a table of records, where each player automatically records his best result - the maximum distance that your car was able to travel on the track.

Start playing now!

games.title: Moto X3M
games.description:
Moto X3M is an awesome bike game with challenging levels. Choose a bike, put your helmet on, pass obstacles, and get ready to beat the time on tons of off-road circuits. Have fun with Moto X3M! The controls are simple – use the keyboard arrow keys to control the acceleration and deceleration, and also your tilt. Ride through each course and try to land your jumps perfectly – if you angle your bike incorrectly you risk tipping your bike over! 
Each level features different obstacles and objects for you to traverse – you will find this game both fun and challenging! This is off-road biking to the max and for any motorbike fan, this game will provide a huge amount of enjoyment!
games.howToPlay:
WASD or ARROWS 
Press the up arrow key to accelerate
Balance your bike with the left and right arrow keys
Break by pressing the down arrow key
Perform flips and other stunts to gain time
Don't crash

games.title: BMG: Ragdoll Car Race
games.description:
"BMG: Ragdoll Car Race" is a crash test simulator with plenty of destruction and obstacles that will easily destroy your car.
Immerse yourself in the crazy world of ragdoll racing, where physics is the main source of fun and unexpected situations. A huge open world awaits you, filled with diverse locations, hidden routes, and challenges that will test not only your speed but also your driving skills. Complete unique levels with varying conditions—from extreme tracks to complex stunt zones—where every collision turns into a spectacular show thanks to a realistic destruction system.
games.howToPlay:
PC Controls:
WASD/Arrow Keys - Movement
Shift - Nitro
Space - Handbrake
R - Restart
Smartphone Controls:
On-Screen Keys

games.title: Car Destruction King
games.description:
Drive different cars, test your strength with rotating hammers, presses, catapults and other obstacles!
Take part in the races and set new records.
Slow down time for a more realistic crash.
Choose different maps and different game modes!

games.title: Realistic Car Crash King
games.description:
Realistic Car Crash King is an extreme crash-test simulator where every collision, rollover, and high-speed impact turns into spectacular destruction. Test different vehicles, accelerate to insane speeds, smash into obstacles, jump from massive ramps, and watch each car deform realistically on impact.

Choose from sports cars, SUVs, trucks, off-road vehicles, and more, then explore a variety of maps including mountain roads, mega ramps, crash-test arenas, obstacle tracks, and open-world sandbox locations. Drop cars from cliffs, crash into traffic, destroy AI vehicles, and find out how much damage each machine can survive.

With realistic physics, detachable parts, dynamic damage, and real-time metal deformation, every crash feels unique and satisfying. Create your own destruction scenarios, perform massive crash tests, and enjoy total freedom to wreck different cars across diverse maps.

Destroy cars and have fun!!

C - Camera Change

games.title: Bus Parking Out
games.description: Logic meets strategy! Operate 3 types of buses in 8 vibrant colors, each requiring careful planning. Enjoy a stunning 3D environment, as you clear the way for the selected bus and collect passengers. Master the art of optimal movement.
games.howToPlay: Players move different colored buses placed in a parking lot, each with its own size and movement direction. The goal of the game is to clear paths to free the selected bus and collect matching passengers in the most efficient way possible.

games.title: TRAFFIC Rush Online
games.description:
TRAFFIC Rush Online is a dynamic 3D driving game set on the streets of a large city. Change lanes between moving cars, control your speed, and prove that you can make it through heavy traffic without mistakes.

Choose from three game modes. Drive with other players online, explore the city without restrictions in Free Ride, or dodge traffic and earn more gold in Traffic mode. Level up, expand your garage, and customize your car with new colors, wheels, and exterior parts.

Responsive driving physics, multiple camera views, and detailed urban roads make every run exciting. Take calculated risks, choose the right moment to move, and set a new record!
games.howToPlay:
The goal of the race is to drive as far as possible along the highway and beat the record.

Try not to crash into other cars. The farther you drive, the more money you will earn.

The game also features an online mode — invite your friends and play together, or meet new players.

Spend the money you earn on upgrading your car and buying new vehicles.

PC Controls:
WASD / Arrow Keys — Drive
C — Change camera
Spacebar — Handbrake

Mobile Controls:
On-screen buttons / on-screen steering wheel. You can switch between control modes in the game settings.

games.title: City Pop Drive
games.description:
City Pop Drive is a one-thumb arcade drive through pastel 80s city pop scenery. 
Pass traffic close to fill the Breeze meter and boost, reach each checkpoint before the timer runs out, and choose the scenic or the express road at every fork. 
Five maps (Seaside, Midnight Expressway, Crossing City, Maple Pass, Snow Resort), each with its own twist and adaptive music that changes with your route, and 25 record-sleeve covers to collect.
games.howToPlay:
Tap to start, then drag left or right to steer (mouse drag, arrow keys or A and D on desktop; P pauses). 
The car accelerates by itself. 
Pass close to traffic for near misses: they add time and fill the Breeze meter, and a full meter starts a Boost that knocks cars aside. 
Reach each checkpoint before the timer ends and pick a side at every fork. 
Reach a goal to collect its cover. 
Spend Miles on upgrades, cars and new maps.

games.title: Steal Car Duel
games.description:
Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal Brainrot Duel into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades! Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

Core Features:
40+ unlockable cars across 8 rarity tiers.
Real-time stealing, dueling, and defense mechanics.
Functional Weapons Shop and Market systems.
Cosmetic customization with outfits, wings, and pets.
Solo and local 2 Player support.
Progressive income and rarity-based rewards.

games.title: Airplane Flight Manager Game

Feel like a real pilot as you control powerful airplanes, fly through clouds, and explore stunning skies. This flight simulator game brings you a real flying experience with easy controls and a beautiful environment. In this flight simulator, you take the seat of a real pilot, control your airplane, and complete missions to reach your destination. The world is open, the sky is yours, and every flight brings a new adventure.

games.title: Car Escape
games.description:
Car Escape - an exhilarating and thrilling traffic escape game that prepares you for every pulse-pounding adventure. Every step counts, and every action can spell the difference between freedom and gridlock. Can you maneuver your car out of the traffic jam and break free?

Start the engine, press the accelerator, and prepare to escape the chaotic and congested streets. But don't be afraid; with your quick reflexes and sharp intellect, you'll soon master the art of navigating through traffic.

games.title: Sunny Bay Heroes
games.description:
Welcome to Sunny Bay, hero! Baron Rust and his Rust Crew have pinched every wheel, engine and propeller in town to
stop the Grand Race. Mayor Marigold needs a hero — and Captain Skye has just flown one in: you.

Explore a whole seaside city with nothing off-limits. Drive jeeps, sports cars, taxis and buses, zip around on a
scooter, fly a helicopter and sail a boat across the bay. Pull the goons out of their getaway vans, race them round
the ring road and soak them with your water blaster. Nobody gets hurt in Sunny Bay — the baddies just get wet, dizzy
and very embarrassed.

21 story missions take you from your first ride to the Grand Race finale, and there is always something to do in
between: coin trails, seven stunt ramps with slow-motion jumps, golden stars, Hero Tasks, taxi, police, ice-cream and
bus shifts, and a daily gift that hands you a brand-new car on the right days. Spend your coins in the SHOP on new
rides, outfits, the turbo and the coin magnet.

Features
- A full open city: downtown, beach, harbor, park, hills and Baron Rust's scrapyard
- Cars, scooters, a helicopter and a boat — call your favourite ride any time
- 21 story missions, races and repeatable side jobs
- Stunt ramps, close calls and big air for bonus coins
- SHOP with 11 rides, outfits and upgrades; daily gifts and Hero Tasks
- Kid-friendly action: water blaster and foam bat, zero violence
- 10 languages, progress saved automatically
