games.title: Eggy Car
games.description: Eggy Car is a simple yet challenging physics-based casual driving game where the goal is to drive as far as possible without letting the egg in your car fall off and crack! Controls are minimal, but finding the right balance between braking and accelerating is crucial, especially when navigating hills. Buckle up and get ready for the (hopefully not) bumpy ride.
games.howToPlay:
Desktop:
Use arrow keys to accelerate and apply brake.
On Mobile:
Tap on paddles to accelerate and apply brake.

games.title: Hedgies
games.description: A single Hedgehog is capable of turning a desolate and abandoned household on plot of land into a bustling and flourishing farm. Only a few of us, people, are aware of the fact that Hedgies are great cooks, fishermen, craftsmen and last, but not the least, fabulously hospitable types! Come and see for yourself, plunge into ‘Hedgies’ game and contribute to the beautification of the Valley.
games.howToPlay: Hedgies is a charming farming game where a hardworking hedgehog transforms an abandoned plot into a thriving homestead. Grow crops, craft goods, and master skills like cooking and fishing. With a warm and welcoming spirit, your hedgehog will turn the valley into a lively community. Step in and help bring this enchanting world to life!

games.title: AOD - Art Of Defense
games.description: AOD - Art Of Defense is a dynamic tower defense game with elements of strategy and RPG in a post-apocalyptic world.
games.howToPlay:
AOD - Art Of Defense is a dynamic tower defense game set in a post-apocalyptic world. As the commander of the A.O.D squad, you lead the fight against the ruthless cutthroats of Mr. Evil, who are seeking to find the lost Project Inola. With stunning isometric graphics, build your tech kingdoms and thwart the destructive ambitions of your enemy. Can you save humanity or will you succumb to darkness?

Game Features:

* Dynamic battles to keep you engaged.
* Elements of tower defense, RPG, and tactical strategy.
* Over 500 sectors for real-time battles.
* Various locations from small villages to huge metropolises.
* New tower defense modes: escape, fog, survival.
* Over 1000 unique upgrades for towers (tanks, miniguns, AA, etc.)
* 6 unique heroes to explore and level up.
* Nuclear bombs, ion satellite attacks, ballistic barrages, and more.
* Hundreds of upgrade cards for each tower.


Build towers! Protect your base! Use tanks, machine guns, and rockets (even nuclear). Upgrade and use heroes. Fight powerful enemies and formidable bosses! Protect your base and save the world!

Use the left mouse button to place a tower.
Use the scroll wheel/pinch to zoom on a touchpad to zoom in or out.

games.title: Age of Heroes
games.description:
Build a hero army, defend towers and conquer eras in Age of Heroes!

Welcome to Age of Heroes — a world where heroes are born, armies march through eras, and every battle decides the fate of an empire. 

Lead an army, build fortresses, and guide your warriors to victory in epic battles from ancient times to the future. RPG elements and tower defense battles await you across eras, wars, and legendary castle sieges! 

Gather an army, develop heroes, protect every tower, and lead your knights through the ages — from ancient battles to futuristic warfare. Each era brings a new battle, a new tower, a new evolution. 

LEAD HEROES TO VICTORY 

You are the strategist and commander who decides the outcome of every battle. 
Create a squad of heroes and pets, combine the power of knights, mages, and warriors from different eras. 
Develop tower defense tactics and strike first. 
• Tactical battles and diverse game modes 
• Tower defense elements and fortress attacks 
• PvP battles between top teams 
• Heroes from different eras ready to fight for territories 

ERAS, CENTURIES AND THE EVOLUTION OF WAR
games.howToPlay:
Summon warriors and heroes from different eras and destroy enemy towers! Journey through all eras and centuries. 
Each brings a new army, unique battles, new wars and legendary heroes. 
• Stone Age — first battles and village defense 
• Middle Ages — knights, sieges and castle battles 
• Age of Gunpowder — fortified towers, artillery and wars 
• Modern Era — aviation, technology and new army evolution 
• Future — energy battles, towers and mechs 
• Space Era — heroes of interplanetary wars 
After completing all eras on Earth, new worlds and planets open up where army and hero evolution continues.

games.title: Avocado Yard: Ragdoll Sandbox
games.description:
Avocado Yard: Ragdoll Sandbox is a free ragdoll physics game where floppy avocados are your toys. Drop them into the yard, make them dance, run, jump and backflip, stack crates and planks, nail things together, tie ropes, set up trampolines, fans, spikes, glass panes, a spinning saw and a cannon, then grab, throw, zap with lightning and blow everything up. Every hit is real-time physics: ragdolls wobble and go flying, red barrels set off chain reactions, balloons float away and a black hole swallows the whole scene.

New: the Magic Wand with six spells. Grow an avocado into a giant king or shrink it to pocket size, make it float, trap it in a soap bubble, bring a knocked-out avocado back to life, or drop a disco ball and watch everyone dance.

Take on 42 challenges, each worth a star; stars unlock premium toys like the homing rocket, the black hole, the mega avocado and the mega bomb. Six maps change the rules: the Yard, night Rooftops, a Construction site with a wrecking ball, a Volcano with a lava floor, a slippery Frozen lake and the low-gravity Moon. Ten hand-made missions give you a clear goal and a handful of moves, and Rampage is a 60-second score attack with a global leaderboard.

Come back every day for a daily gift that grows over a 7-day streak and three fresh daily quests. Spend the pits you earn on skins from Ninja and Zombie to Robot and King, or on new maps and toys. Exclusive toys such as the jetpack, car, turret, Tesla coil, tornado, minigun and portals unlock forever with one short optional ad. Your yard is saved automatically.

No download needed: play in the browser on PC, tablet and phone, in English, Spanish, German or Russian, with touch controls, keyboard shortcuts and a short guided tutorial.
games.howToPlay:
Build a scene, play with physics and complete challenges to earn stars.

- Place items: pick a toy on the shelf (Avocado, Crate, Rock, Plank, Bomb, Barrel, Anvil, Balloon, Trampoline, Spikes, Fan, Glass and more), then tap or click the field.
- Grab: press on an object, drag and release to throw it. A quick tap on an avocado opens its moves.
- Moves: pick Moves and tap an avocado to make it run, dance, backflip, jump, flex, dab, floss or kick, or tap "Everyone dance".
- Wand: pick a spell in the row above the shelf (Grow, Shrink, Float, Bubble, Revive, Disco), then tap an avocado or a toy. Tap a bubble to pop it.
- Blast: tap the field to set off an explosion. Pistol: press, drag toward the target and release. Zap: tap to call down lightning.
- Freeze: tap an object to lock it in place, tap again to release it. Delete: tap an object to remove it.
- Nail and Rope: tap an object, then another object or the background.
- Challenges and Daily: tap the star panel at the top left for goals, the daily gift, quests and skins.
- Modes: pick a map, play missions (limited moves, up to three stars each) or Rampage (60 seconds of damage for the leaderboard).
- Premium toys unlock with stars, pits or a short optional ad. Exclusive toys unlock forever after one optional ad.
- Top bar: pause, slow motion, gravity, clear, reset, Modes, sound, language, how to play.
- Keyboard: Space pause, S slow motion, G gravity, C clear, R reset, T Rampage, D delete, M avocado, Esc grab.

games.title: Merge Wall: Last Stand
games.description: Merge Wall: Last Stand is a bright merge tower-defense game. Hordes of goblins, wolves, skeletons, ogres and fire-breathing dragons march on your castle - only your wall and your army stand in the way! Summon fighters, drag two identical heroes together to merge them into a stronger one, and grow a squad of 10 hero tiers: knights, archers, wizards and more, each with its own special attack. Every monster fights differently: wolves pounce, bats dodge, shamans heal, trolls roar and dragons rain fireballs. Choose blessings between waves, cast meteor, freeze, repair and rage spells, and defeat epic bosses. Clear a 60-mission campaign across meadows, snowfields and lava lands, then test yourself in Endless mode. Upgrade heroes and your castle, open treasure chests, spin the wheel of fortune, complete daily quests and achievements.
games.howToPlay: Tap SUMMON to call a fighter onto the grid - it costs gold, which you earn by defeating monsters. Drag a fighter onto another fighter of the same level to merge them into a stronger hero. Your army attacks automatically; keep monsters from breaking your wall. Between waves pick one of three blessings. Tap spell buttons to cast meteor, freeze, wall repair or rage. Survive all waves to win the mission and earn up to 3 stars. Controls: mouse or touch - click/tap and drag.

games.title: Build an Aquapark
games.description:
🎢 Welcome to the craziest water park! 💦

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.
games.howToPlay:
🛒 Buy water slide parts!
🛠️ Build a water slide!
💦 Jump on the water ring and slide down!
⬆️ Upgrade your slide with even cooler parts!
🌟 Show everyone the most epic water slide!

games.title: Farm Care Tycoon
games.description:
Welcome to Farm Care Tycoon, where your farm, your rules and your empire start here! 🚜

In Farm Care Tycoon you start with a few empty fields and build the most stacked farm in town. Grow crops, raise cute animals, fire up factories and keep your shop shelves full while customers line up to buy. Every coin unlocks new land, new animals and new machines, and the bigger you build, the faster the money rolls in.

🌽 10 crops to grow: wheat, corn, potatoes, tomatoes, broccoli, pineapples, onions, bell peppers, cucumbers and strawberries
🐔 Raise animals: chickens, cows, sheep and pigs
🏭 Run factories: bake bread, press juice, make jam and weave fabric
🛒 Run your shop: stock the shelves and serve a never-ending line of customers
🚚 Drive the truck: carry way more and move faster
⚡ Power boosts: double your income or your speed
🎡 Lucky wheel: free spins with cash and boost prizes
📈 Level up and upgrade: carry more and upgrade your farms, animals and factories

Super satisfying, easy to pick up and impossible to put down. How big can your farm grow in Farm Care Tycoon?
games.howToPlay:
🎮 Move: drag on the screen (mobile) · WASD or arrow keys, or click and drag (desktop)

🌱 Farm: walk onto your fields to plant and harvest crops.
🧺 Carry: you pick up goods automatically. The counter at the top shows how much you're carrying.
🛒 Stock and sell: bring goods to the matching shelves. Customers buy them and pay at the checkout.
💵 Collect: walk over the cash piles to grab your money.
🔓 Expand: stand on an unlock spot to spend money on new fields, animals and factories.
⬆️ Upgrade: open the Upgrade menu to improve your Farms, Animals and Factories.
⭐ Level up: fill the star bar to level up and carry more.
🎁 Bonuses: grab Income ⚡ and Speed boosts, jump in the truck, and spin the free wheel every 10 minutes.

games.title: Dungeon Shop Rush
games.description:
Warriors, mages, rogues and nine more kinds of heroes line up at your counter, and every one of them is in a hurry. Drag the right sword, potion or scroll to each hero before their patience runs out, chain customers into combos for bigger tips and enchant wares at the glowing station for double pay.

Between shifts, pick a contract that changes the rules, stock your shelf with 18 wares, license new goods and spend your coins on upgrades: friendlier counters, bigger shelves, faster restocks and price tags that pay off. Renovate the shop with new walls, counters, lights and decor, fill your collection of heroes, wares and relics, and finish daily, weekly and guild tasks.

Shifts get busier as your reputation grows, and reputation never stops growing. Climb the "Best shift" leaderboard and show who runs the finest shop in the dungeon!
games.howToPlay:
Drag an item from the shelf onto the hero who ordered it, or tap the item and then the hero. Orders marked "Enchanted" need the enchanting station first: drop an ordinary item on it, wait a moment and drag the glowing result to the hero. Tap an empty item to restock it. Serve heroes back-to-back to raise your combo and open combo chests. Reach half of the shift's coin goal to pass, and the full goal for three stars. Spend coins on upgrades and wares between shifts.

Controls: mouse or touch (drag and drop, or tap). Esc pauses the shift.

games.title: Burger Bay
games.description:
Burger Bay is an idle burger shop on the beach. Cook patties, stack burgers, serve customers and collect cash to unlock new stations, hire helpers and grow your boardwalk along the coast to new beaches.

Every few minutes a sea-creature boss shows up: a Kraken, a giant crab or a whale with a mega order and a countdown. Serve it in time for a huge payout.
games.howToPlay:
Walk to stations to cook and carry food, then serve the customers. Spend cash on new stations, upgrades and helpers. Serve the sea-monster orders before the timer runs out.

Controls: Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to walk, T to toss the top item, P to pause. Mobile: drag to walk.

games.title: Lighthouse Mage: Idle Defense
games.description: Idle tower defense on a tiny island. Your lighthouse fires magic bolts at crabs, jellyfish, eels, pirate rafts and huge sea bosses that come from every side. Spend gold on damage, defense and magic during the run, collect pearls and relics for permanent upgrades, unlock four spells and sail on to icy, volcanic and abyss seas. Steer the lighthouse beam yourself for double damage.
games.howToPlay: The lighthouse shoots by itself. Tap upgrade cards at the bottom (Attack, Defense, Magic) to spend gold on damage, attack speed, health, armor and income. Hold and drag on the sea (mouse or finger) to aim the lighthouse beam: it deals double damage. Cast spells with the buttons on the right. Every 10th wave brings a boss. When the lighthouse falls, spend pearls in the Harbor on permanent upgrades and try again to reach a higher wave.

games.title: Knight's Arena - Castle Defense
games.description:
The castle is surrounded, and only one hero can stop the assault. Charge into the enemy horde, deliver crushing blows, and do not let them break through to the fortress.

Each victory makes you stronger. Find weapons and armor, upgrade your equipment, and prepare for new, more dangerous opponents.

- Dynamic close-combat battles
- Powerful weapons and durable armor
- Continuous hero upgrades
- Castle defense against advancing enemies
- Simple controls on computers and phones
games.howToPlay:
Goal — protect the castle by defeating enemies and strengthening the hero with weapons and armor you find. Do not let opponents break through to the fortress, and choose a safe moment to attack.

Controls:

On desktop: use WASD to move; use the left mouse button to attack and interact.

On mobile: swipe across the screen to move; tap the screen to attack and interact.

games.title: Catcha
games.description: Catcha is a cozy pixel-art cat collecting game. Fill your room with cats, and when two of them fall in love they leave you a mystery gift box. Open boxes to discover cats of six rarities, from Common to Super, on collectible cards: HOLO, R-HOLO, G-HOLO, STAR and the rarest FULL ART. Buy and sell boxes and cats at the Auction, complete your Album, level up, and let your favorite cats stroll in the Garden. Over 100 cat skins, a room that changes from morning to night, and your progress is saved automatically.
games.howToPlay: Collect as many cats as you can and complete the Album. Left click / tap to open gift boxes, buttons and menus. Drag a cat to pick it up and move it; release to drop it, or fling it to toss it. Put two cats that are ready for love (hearts above their heads) close together and they will make a gift box. Open boxes to get new cats, sell or buy them at the Auction, and level up.

games.title: Loot Hole
games.description: Loot Hole is a cartoony first-person digging game. Dig down through your front yard, find buried treasure, carry it up and sell it at your yard stall. Spend your coins on better shovels, pickaxes and drills, bigger backpacks, jetpacks and explosives, then dig deeper through ever harder layers of rock on the way to the bottom, 1000 m down. Every layer ends in a hidden landmark with a guaranteed rare find, neighbours stop by the board asking for things you've dug up, and a collection book keeps everything you've found.
games.howToPlay: Hold the left mouse button (or touch and hold on a phone) to dig where you aim. Walk near a find to put it in your backpack. When the backpack is full, press H to go back to the surface and walk into the yard stall to sell everything. Buy better tools and bigger backpacks at the tool shed to dig through harder layers and reach the bottom. Keyboard: WASD to move, mouse to look, Space to jump (or use the jetpack), H to surface, B or I for the backpack, C for the collection, X to throw an explosive, Q to switch its kind. On phones and tablets, use the on-screen stick and buttons.

games.title: Needle Rush
games.description: An idle clicker about finding one needle in a haystack of ten million straws. Dig the stack down by hand, sell the hay and spend it on better tools: a rake, a pitchfork, a shovel, a vacuum and dynamite. Hire farmhands and build claw arms, fans, winches, hay robots and drones that dig for you. The hay behaves like a real pile: it slides, caves in and spills into the bins. Claim achievements, and find the needle faster each time. Hand-made pixel art.
games.howToPlay: Dig the haystack until you find the needle hidden inside. Hay you dig falls into the bins and turns into coins. Spend coins in the shop on better tools, farmhands and machines that dig for you. Mouse: hold the left button on the haystack to dig, click a card in the shop to buy it. Touch: hold a finger on the haystack, or on the strip under the barn when the phone is upright, and tap a card to buy it. Tap the needle when you uncover it to win.

games.title: Ultimate Horse Simulator
games.description:
Experience the exciting life of a wild horse in Ultimate Horse Simulator! Explore a beautiful savanna jungle, build your horse family, protect your babies, and survive against dangerous wild animals in this thrilling horse survival adventure.

Play as a powerful Arabian horse, find your mate, and raise your family in the wilderness. Search for food and water, feed your baby horses, and protect your family from lions, tigers, wolves, bears, and other predators.

Complete challenging survival missions, fight wild animals using special attack powers, and earn coins to unlock new horses and upgrades. Explore the forest, discover safe places for your family, and become the strongest horse in the jungle.

 Features
- Play as a wild Arabian horse
- Build and protect your horse family
- Raise and feed baby horses
- Explore a beautiful savanna jungle
- Fight lions, tigers, wolves, and other predators
- Use special powers and energy ball attacks
- Complete exciting survival and fighting missions
- Collect coins and unlock new horses
- Find food and water to maintain energy
- Detailed 3D environments and animal sounds

Explore, survive, fight predators, and raise your horse family in Ultimate Horse Simulator!
games.howToPlay:
Desktop:
Sprint = Shift Key
Attack = E 
Special Attack 1 = V
Special Attack 2 = X
Action = F
Skip Level = N 
Pause =P 
Setting =Ctrl 
Info = I 

Mobile:
On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

games.title: Jelly Sandbox Playground
games.description:
Jelly Sandbox is a 2D ragdoll sandbox where you can create your own scenes, experiment with characters, weapons, objects, and vehicles, and enjoy realistic physics interactions. Place characters on the level, collide them with objects, launch items across the map, trigger destruction, and watch how every situation plays out.

There are no strict goals or required missions — you decide what happens in the sandbox. Create calm experiments or turn the level into an arena full of chaotic battles. Every object reacts to impacts, falls, and collisions, so each experiment feels dynamic and different.

Features:
• 2D ragdoll physics
• open sandbox gameplay
• weapons, objects, and vehicles
• destruction and physics-based interactions
• create your own scenes and battles
• simple and intuitive controls
games.howToPlay:
Choose a character, object, weapon, or vehicle and place it on the game scene. Drag and move objects, collide them with each other, and watch the ragdoll physics react in real time.

Create any situation you want: place characters, add weapons and props, launch objects, and build your own battles or experiments. There is no required objective — you are free to play the way you like.

Use the interface to select and place objects. On desktop, the game is controlled with a mouse. On mobile devices, use touch controls.

games.title: Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D
games.description:
Lead your own burger adventure!

Dive into the exciting world of restaurant management, where you will cook delicious dishes, expand your business and delight customers in this exciting simulation game.

From frying juicy burgers to managing staff, every decision you make is important on the way to creating a real culinary empire!

🔑 Key features:
🍔 Cook and serve: Create a variety of burgers, crispy fries, juicy nuggets, refreshing drinks and aromatic coffee.

💰 Burger tycoon: Manage finances, upgrade equipment and hire employees.
✨ Expand and decorate: Use profits to create a unique interior.
🚀 Develop a network: Open new branches with car services!
⏰ New horizons: Launch a trendy cafe or food truck!

games.title: Soccer Random
games.description:
Soccer Random is a funny physics-based soccer game where every match feels unpredictable from the first kick. Instead of following the style of a serious football simulation, it turns soccer into a fast, chaotic, and easy-to-play challenge built around one-button controls. Your goal is simple: jump, kick, defend, and try to score before your opponent reaches the winning number of goals. The rules are clear, but the movement is never fully predictable, which is what makes each round so entertaining.

The game uses ragdoll-style character movement, so players do not run, turn, or shoot in a traditional way. They bounce, fall, stretch, and swing toward the ball with awkward timing. A perfect-looking attack can suddenly miss, while a strange jump may turn into an unexpected goal. This mix of timing, reaction, and random physics gives Soccer Random its playful identity. It is easy to understand in seconds, but every match still creates surprising moments.

One of the strongest parts of Soccer Random is how the game changes between rounds. The field, players, weather-like conditions, ball behavior, and match rhythm can shift after a goal. You may play on a regular soccer field in one round, then face a slippery or unusual setup in the next. These random changes keep the experience fresh and stop the matches from feeling repetitive. Players must quickly adapt instead of relying on the same move every time.

Soccer Random can be played alone against the CPU, but it becomes even more enjoyable in local 2-player mode. Two players can share the same device and compete in short, messy football duels where both sides are dealing with the same unpredictable movement. Because the controls are simple, the match stays focused on timing, quick reactions, and funny mistakes rather than complicated button combinations.

The pixel art style gives the game a clean, retro look that fits well with its arcade feeling. The visuals are simple enough to keep the action easy to follow, while the strange animations make every goal, save, and missed kick more memorable. A small bounce, a late jump, or an accidental block can completely change the result of a round.

For players who enjoy quick soccer games, local 2-player challenges, and funny sports games with random physics, Soccer Random offers a light but highly replayable experience. It works well for short sessions because the matches start quickly, the goal is always clear, and every round can produce a new kind of chaos. Whether you are trying to beat the CPU or challenge a friend, Soccer Random keeps football simple, strange, and entertaining from one goal to the next.
games.howToPlay:
Player 1: W
Player 2: UP ARROW

Jump, kick, and defend with one key. Adapt to random physics and score more goals than your rival.

games.title: Basketball Stars
games.description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2-player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!
games.howToPlay:
1 player controls
WASD or arrow keys to move
X/L to shoot/steal
S to pump/block
A+A or D+D or left/right arrow twice to dash
K/Z to super shot

2 player controls
To move, player 1 use the WASD keys and player 2 use arrow keys
To shoot/steal, player 1 use B and player 2 use L
To pump, player 1 use S and player 2 use down arrow
To dash, player 1 use A/D twice and player 2 use left/right arrow twice
K to super shot

games.title: 2 Minute Football QB Legend
games.description: 2 Minute Football QB Legend 27 focuses on the best parts of football - strategy, completing passes and scoring TD's! We make it as easy as possible -- just start passing with a single tap on the screen. There are no complicated control schemes, only pure touchdown bliss! Play live offense and match up against simulated opponents to win your way to the World Championship! Now with Kickoff Return, Field Goals, 2 Point conversions and more!
games.howToPlay:
Your goal is to complete passes and score Touchdowns! (getting the ball in the end zone)  You must have more points than your opponent when the game ends in order to win the games. 

Select a play by tapping it. When the players start moving, look for the player that is the least guarded by the defense. Tap near the player you'd like to throw the ball to. Running is automatic, but can be controlled by clicking and dragging the mouse to the left of right, or dragging your finger on touch devices.

games.title: Basket Random
games.description:
Basket Random is a chaotic arcade basketball game where every match turns into a funny test of timing, luck, and unpredictable physics. Instead of giving players a serious sports simulation, it focuses on quick rounds, simple controls, and hilarious ragdoll movement. You control your team with one key, jump toward the ball, block your opponent, and try to score before the other side reaches the winning point. The idea is easy to understand, but the random physics make every attempt feel different.

What makes Basket Random stand out is the way it changes after almost every score. One round may take place on a normal court, while the next may throw you into a completely different setup with unusual players, strange body proportions, or a ball that behaves in an unexpected way. Sometimes the characters have long arms, sometimes their movement feels heavier, and sometimes the ball bounces in a way that makes even a simple shot difficult to predict. This constant variety keeps the game fresh without making it complicated.

The controls are intentionally simple, which makes the game accessible for almost anyone. In single-player mode, you can play against the CPU and practice your timing. In 2-player mode, the game becomes even more entertaining because both players share the same device and compete in fast, messy basketball duels. Since both sides are dealing with the same strange physics, every point feels like a mix of skill, reaction, and comedy.

Basket Random is especially enjoyable for players who like short sports games with instant action. You do not need to learn complex moves, manage a team, or follow advanced basketball rules. The goal is clear: jump, reach the ball, defend your basket, and score. However, the challenge comes from reading the movement of your characters and adapting quickly when the game changes the court, the players, or the ball behavior.

The pixel-style visuals give the game a clean and playful look, while the ragdoll animation creates many unexpected moments. A missed jump can turn into a lucky block. A bad shot can bounce into the basket. A perfect attack can fail because your player lands in the wrong position. These small surprises are the reason Basket Random feels fun even after many rounds.

For fans of funny basketball games, local 2-player games, and physics-based sports challenges, Basket Random offers a simple but highly replayable experience. It is easy to start, fast to understand, and unpredictable enough to keep every match exciting. Whether you are playing alone or challenging a friend, each round brings a new chance to score a ridiculous basket, make a surprising comeback, or laugh at a completely unexpected play.
games.howToPlay:
Player 1: W
Player 2: UP ARROW

Jump, block, and shoot with one key. Time your moves well and score before your opponent.

games.title: Golf Orbit
games.description:
Golf Orbit is an exciting golf simulator game within sports category where you aim to launch golf balls to incredible heights, even reaching Mars. Have fun in one-shot golf battles, complete challenging levels, and master the art of the perfect shot. Compete to become the golf king in this entertaining and unique golfing adventure.

Core: A vibrant and highly accessible casual sports title centered on the fundamentals of golf.
Loop: Player skill is directly rewarded with in-game currency for successful long-range shots, facilitating a clear progression path through continuous gear upgrades.
Start: The game features highly intuitive controls and is immediately engaging, supported by a robust system of mini-quests to drive early-game retention.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a polished Stylized / Cartoon art direction, providing an appealing and universally pleasant visual experience.
Key Feature: Offers an enjoyable blend of satisfying gameplay challenge coupled with eye-catching, high-quality graphics.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons and move the cursor.
Mobile: Tap buttons with your finger, drag your finger across the screen.

Key Features:
• Hit Accurately! : Try to hit the green indicator for a stronger shot and to make the ball fly further!
• Hit the Green Zones! : Did you hit the green zone? Great! Now take another shot!
• Obstacles on the Field! : Hit harder to make the ball fly higher! There can be various obstacles on the field, like trees, rocks, or even someone's house...

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go play golf! Hit the ball as far as possible and try to get it into the holes.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Get the ball into the holes or the green zones, then take another shot. Aim more accurately to avoid missing, or you'll have to start over!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?
A: Try to hit the green section on the indicator when you take a shot. This way, you can hit harder, and your ball will fly further!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?
A: Upgrade your abilities: ball flight speed, shot power, and more. Get better and hit the target directly!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Spin the wheel of fortune to earn more rewards. Test your luck!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Play however you feel comfortable! You can choose to turn off the sound.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first moments of the game, you'll immediately understand how to play! Improve your skills shot by shot!
games.howToPlay:
The key to Golf Orbit is to aim and hit the golf ball as far as possible. This one-button game has relatively easy gameplay, but getting that perfect shot can be challenging. Tap and hold your left mouse button to set the power and release to hit the ball. As the ball soars, it bounces off various objects, gaining extra distance but, if you hit a perfect shot, the ball can destroy the obstacles it faces, including trees and buildings.

As in regular golf, if your ball ends in water or in sand bunkers

Your distance will be recorded with each shot, keeping you accountable for your progress. The goal is to achieve the longest distance possible with each swing.

Collect coins during the flight to upgrade your equipment and improve your shots. The goal is to achieve the longest distance possible with each swing. Points can be accumulated in various ways. The longer the distance you shoot, the more points you get. You can also unlock points with a surprise spin.

If you score a birdie (hole in 2 shots) or an eagle (hole in one), you'll amass way more points and will be able to improve the features of your future shots.

There are three elements to a perfect shot: strength, speed, and bounce. You can give each one of these a boost with reward points.

games.title: Reel & Slash II - Beach Legends
games.description:
Reel & Slash II: Beach Legends is a 3D beach fishing game where every cast turns into a fight.

Cast from the shoreline, wait for the bite, then reel hard and finish the fish with your sword. The bigger the catch, the harder it pulls, and the more coins it pays.

- 100 real fish species across 10 levels, from a 1 cm pygmy goby to a 26 metre humpback whale
- Rods, lures, swords and bows to buy, each one stronger than the last
- Accessories, skins, cars and jetskis to unlock
- A Fishdex to fill, and a beach full of anglers with their own gear and names

Drive a car along the sand and smash through the floating coins, or take a jetski out to sea and hunt the golden multiplier rings that multiply everything you collect.

Can you land the whale?
games.howToPlay:
DESKTOP

Move - W A S D (read by physical key position, so it also works on AZERTY)
Cast - hold SPACE at the water's edge, release to throw. Hold longer to cast further.
Strike, reel and shoot - F or the left mouse button
Aim the bow - drag the mouse while SPACE is held
Interact with shops, cars and jetskis - E
Fishdex - Q
Switch tool (rod, sword, bow) - 1 2 3
Pause - P or Esc

MOBILE

Move - the on-screen joystick at the bottom left
Cast, reel, strike - the big round button at the bottom right
Switch tool - the three buttons just above it
Interact - tap the prompt that appears on screen

games.howToPlay:
Chess Online Multiplayer follows the classic rules of chess. The goal of the game is to checkmate your opponent’s king, putting it in a position where it is under threat of capture and has no legal moves to escape.

**Getting Started**

1. **Choose the game type:**
* play online against other players;
* challenge the computer;
* play together on the same screen with a friend.

2. **If you’re playing against the computer:**
* select the opponent’s difficulty level (from Beginner to World Champion);
* choose whether to use a handicap and interactive hints.

3. **If you’re playing with a friend:**
* decide on the time control mode (Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic).
* choose your bet

**Basic Rules and Gameplay**

* Players take turns making moves.
* Pawns move forward and capture diagonally.
* Knights move in an «L» shape.
* Other pieces have their own unique moves.

To succeed, develop a strategy: protect your pieces, control the center of the board, and anticipate your opponent’s moves.

The game ends when one player checkmates the opponent’s king (winning the game) or when a draw is achieved under certain conditions.

**Draw Conditions**
A draw is a result where neither player wins, and the game ends in a tie. It can occur under the following circumstances:
* **stalemate:** when a player has no legal moves but is not in check;
* **three-fold repetition of the position:** when the same position occurs three times;
* **50 moves without a capture or pawn move;**
* **insufficient material to checkmate;**
* mutual agreement between players.

**Special Chess Moves**

**Castling**
Castling is a special move involving the king and a rook. It can be performed only if:
* neither the king nor the rook has moved yet;
* there are no other pieces between the king and the rook;
* the king is not in check;
* the king does not pass through or stop on squares that are under attack.

This move helps to protect the king and connect the rooks for better defense.

**En Passant (Taking on Pass)**
En passant is a special pawn capture. If your opponent moves a pawn two squares forward and lands next to your pawn, you can capture it on your next move as if it had moved only one square. Your pawn will take its place, but this capture must be done immediately.

**Additional Features**

* **Made a mistake?** Use the move undo function to reconsider your strategy.
* After each match, a detailed analysis highlights mistakes and suggests better moves.

games.howToPlay:
**How to Play English Checkers**

English Checkers is a strategic board game where players aim to capture their opponent’s checkers or block them completely. Here’s how to get started and understand the basic rules:

**Game Objective**
The goal is to either capture all of your opponent’s checkers or completely block them so they can’t make any legal moves.

**Types of Checkers**
- **Simple checker:** moves diagonally forward one square and can only capture forward.
- **King:** can move diagonally both forward and backward on any free square and can capture in both directions. When a simple checker reaches the last row, it becomes a king and gains these additional abilities.

**Basic Movement and Capture Rules**
1. **Movement:**
- simple checkers move diagonally forward one square at a time;
- kings can move diagonally in any direction on any free square.

2. **Capture:**
- if your checker is next to your opponent’s checker and there’s an empty square behind it, you must jump over the opponent’s checker and land in the empty square, capturing the opponent’s piece;
- captures are mandatory — if you have the option to capture, you must do so;
- if a capture leads to another possible capture, you must continue capturing as part of the same turn until no more captures are possible;
- when a simple checker reaches the last row during a capture, it becomes a king but cannot make further moves in the same turn.

3. **Choosing Capture Options:**
- if there are multiple capture options available, you can choose which one to make;
- the «Turkish strike» rule means that a checker that has been beaten but not yet removed from the board can block the path of a king or another checker.

**Winning the Game**
You win the game by:
- capturing all of your opponent’s checkers;
- blocking your opponent so that they have no legal moves left.

**Getting Started in English Checkers Online Multiplayer**
1. **Choose your game mode:** play against the computer, compete online with real players, or play with a friend on the same screen.
2. **Select your difficulty level or opponent:** if playing against the computer, choose from 10 difficulty levels; if playing online, find a real opponent.
3. **Choose your side:** select whether you want to play as black or white.
4. **Start playing:** follow the rules of movement and capture to outmanoeuvre your opponent and achieve victory.

Enjoy the game and sharpen your strategic skills with English Checkers Online Multiplayer!

Words must connect to what is already on the board, and every word you form is checked against the dictionary of the chosen language. Premium squares multiply a letter or the whole word, and using all your tiles in one turn earns a bonus.

games.title: Quizmania: Trivia game
games.description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.
games.howToPlay: The player must answer quiz questions by selecting the correct answer from four options. Players can use hints to assist in answering. Progress is tracked through a bar that fills as they play, allowing them to unlock and use clues for future questions.

games.title: Guess Monster Voice
games.description: Get ready for a thrilling sound-based challenge with "Guess Monster Voice." In this exciting online game, you’ll identify legendary creatures by their chilling noises. Available on both mobile and desktop, dive into the realm of mythical beings and demonstrate your skills—all for free.

games.title: Emoji Guess
games.description: Show off your skills as an emoji interpreter in this supremely fun and frenetic puzzle game where you have to pick the right set of emojis to express the phrase, saying or movie title that’s written or illustrated above. Solve endless emoji puzzles by matching the right emojis in the right order and sharpen your logic, word association and visual perception skills with hundreds of short, colorful and often hilarious levels of brain-teasing entertainment. Emoji Guess Puzzle is a simple-in-concept but endlessly challenging and amusing puzzle game for smart players of all ages.
games.howToPlay:
Your goal is to pick the correct sequence of emojis that represent the phrase, saying, or movie title shown above the puzzle. Think of it as translating text or ideas into emoji form in the right order.
Each level presents a prompt (text-based or illustrated) and a jumble of emojis.
You select emojis in the precise order needed to match the intended phrase.
If you're correct on the first try, you earn all the stars for that level. Otherwise, you’ll get additional attempts with guidance.
Stuck on a puzzle? The game offers helpful hints that can nudge you in the right direction without giving the full answer away.

games.title: Mindblow
games.description:
Welcome to Mindblow: Guess the Word! Experience a word-guessing game like no other, where every image cleverly hides a word. Unlike other games, this game isn’t just a mix of stock images, but we've carefully created each level’s image to challenge your brain! Discover the word through a concept creatively depicted in each picture.

A New Kind of Puzzle: Forget what you know about word quiz games. In Mindblow: Guess the Word, each image has a special word for you to guess. It’s not just about looking at the picture, but understanding the clever idea behind it.
games.howToPlay:
From easy peasy to brain-busters, we’ve got levels for every player. Earn coins for right guesses and use them for hints when stuck.
Guess the Word handy on your device. New levels are added to Mindblow every month, so there’s always something fresh to enjoy.
Guess the Word, start your journey of amazing pictures and satisfying word discoveries. Are you up for the challenge?

games.title: GeoVex - Daily Geography Challenge
games.description:
The daily map challenge for flag and geography nerds.

GeoVex is an engaging daily educational puzzle game that puts your world geography knowledge to the test.
In this map-based trivia challenge, you are presented with a series of national flags and must pinpoint their exact location on the globe. 

Play on Easy mode to see country names and map borders, or test your true expertise on Hard mode, with a completely borderless map!
Compete in the 10-round Daily Challenge to build your daily streak and share your score with friends!
games.howToPlay:
Your goal is to identify the flag, find the country on the map, place your pin, and rack up the highest score possible!

Controls:
• PC: Click and drag to pan the map, use the mouse wheel to zoom, and left-click to drop your flag pin.
• Mobile: Swipe to pan the map, pinch to zoom, and tap to drop your flag pin.

Once you place your pin, click the "Submit" button to confirm your guess. If your pin lands perfectly inside the correct country, you earn a maximum of 10 points. If you miss, you are awarded partial points based on your distance from the target (5 points within 500km, 3 points within 1000km, and 1 point within 2000km). Complete all rounds to get your final score and share your results with your friends!

games.title: Connect Associations
games.description:
A set of words hides several meaningful connections. Find four words that share a theme and merge them step by step into one group. Correct matches reveal categories, while later levels introduce fresh word sets and ice obstacles.

The relaxed pace gives you time to consider every move. Hints can keep the solution moving when a connection is especially tricky. Complete levels, earn coins, and watch your overall progress grow.
games.howToPlay:
1. Find two words that belong to the same theme.
2. Tap the first word and then the second, or drag one onto the other.
3. Keep adding related words until the group contains all four.
4. Every correct merge damages the ice. Free frozen words before using them.
5. Reveal every category to complete the level.

Incorrect pairs cost one attempt. If you get stuck, shuffle the words or use a hint.

games.title: Flag Learn
games.description:
Flag Learn is a geography quiz game that helps you truly memorize every flag,
capital, and US state — not just guess them. A smart spaced-repetition system
tracks each flag you've seen and brings back the ones you struggle with until
you master them all. Beyond the learning mode, you'll find a whole collection
of challenges: Daily Flagle, Paint the Flag, Border Guess, timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard,
and real-time PvP battles against friends. Clean night-sky design, satisfying
progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions
and serious learning.
games.howToPlay:
Learn and master all world flags, US states, and capitals. A flag appears —
type its name and confirm. Answer correctly 3 times in a row to master a flag
and add it to your collection. Mistakes cost a life; lives refill over time or
by watching a short ad. Master the full collection to become a true Flag
Master!

Try the Challenges: guess the daily flag in Daily Flagle, identify blurred
flags in Blur Mode, color flags in Paint the Flag, recognize countries by
their outline in Border Guess, race the clock in Highscore speedruns, or
battle friends in real-time PvP.

Desktop Controls:
Keyboard: Type the country, state, or capital name.
Enter: Submit your answer.
Mouse: Navigate menus, select modes, and pick colors in Paint the Flag.

Mobile Controls:
Tap: Navigate menus and select answers.
On-Screen Keyboard: Type your answer, then tap Check.

games.title: Cryptograms: Secret Text
games.description:
Cryptograms: Secret Text -  is a puzzle game where you decipher encrypted phrases, gradually uncovering letters and piecing together the full meaning.

Choose a theme to match your mood: love and relationships, wisdom and philosophy, movies and TV shows, motivation and literature – and progress through levels one by one.

Progress and Rewards:

Earn coins for completing levels, which can be used to access hints.
games.howToPlay:
In each puzzle, some letters are hidden, while others must be guessed to restore the phrase.

Keep track of your mistakes and reveal letters carefully.

If you get stuck – use hints (e.g., lightbulb/search) and continue solving.
